title: Assess the current economy, army and fortification allocation
acceptance: Use recent gameplay to choose one falsifiable allocation hypothesis. Compare matched private cases with relevant horizons, spending, production, delivered troops and queue occupancy. Explain benefits, costs and evidence limits; a supported rejection is a valid result.
nextStep: Read current strategy and live evidence. Inspect previous experiments, select one high-value question, and submit a matched baseline/candidate experiment if the answer is not already supported.
